text_block_list.text: One day, when I went out to buy supplies――
I noticed Eishin Flash standing in front of a shop, lost in thought.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I came to buy stollen, but due to an unexpected circumstance with the shop owner, it appears they are temporarily closed.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, there will be a major delay in the schedule...
This was unexpected. What on earth should we doâ

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...That thought hadn't crossed my mind.
However――you are entirely correct.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: If they don't have it, I can simply make it. Fortunately, I have frequented this place often enough to vividly recall the taste.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Using my father and mother's stollen recipes as a baseline, I can replicate an approximation of the flavor.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for the advice.
I'll head back to the dorm and try making it right away.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Just as you say. Considering our current situation,
we ought to prepare options for the future.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, my current schedule consists of
'taking a walk, and purchasing stollen.'

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Searching for another shop falls within the parameters of a stroll, so everything is proceeding as scheduled.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, I must overcome all odds
and find another store in time...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for the advice.
I'll go look for other shops right away.
